name: Dirty John
description: Anthology series in which each season is based on a true crime story featuring an epic tale of love gone wrong.

videos.title: Dirty John, the Dirty Truth
videos.overview: Explores the past of con man “Dirty” John Meehan and his trail of manipulation that led to a dangerous end with Debra Newell and her family. Features exclusive interviews with former girlfriends and law enforcement who speak out for the first time.

videos.title: Approachable Dreams
videos.overview: Debra Newell has a seemingly perfect life: she’s successful, beautiful and lives in one of California’s most desirable coastal cities, Newport Beach. The only thing missing is love. So when Debra finally meets charming and handsome doctor John Meehan, she’s quickly swept into a whirlwind romance, much to her daughters’ dismay.

videos.title: Red Flags and Parades
videos.overview: Debra and John revel secretly in their newlywed bliss, as Veronica, Terra, and Toby hatch a plan to prove their suspicions about their mother’s new man.

videos.title: Remember It Was Me
videos.overview: Debra discovers John’s criminal record. In the past, John starts his first family.

videos.title: Shrapnel
videos.overview: Debra confronts John in the present, while we learn more about Arlane’s past.

videos.title: Lord High Executioner
videos.overview: John gets clean for Debra. Terra learns John’s back. John puts his sister through the ringer.

videos.title: One Shoe
videos.overview: Debra makes a decision about John. In Ohio, John captures the attention of Detective Dennis Luken.

videos.title: Chivalry
videos.overview: A look at how John operates while Debra tries to move forward.

videos.title: This Young Woman Fought Like Hell
videos.overview: John and Debra's relationship comes to a head in an unexpected way.

videos.title: No Fault
videos.overview: Betty thinks she can't be divorced by her rich lawyer husband without her consent.

videos.title: The Turtle and the Alligator
videos.overview: Through medical school, law school and many pregnancies, Betty supports Dan until he hits it big.

videos.title: Marriage Encounter
videos.overview: A worried Betty takes a desperate step to save her marriage, and it works. Until it doesn’t.

videos.title: More to It Than Fun
videos.overview: Betty sees her life has been a sham for years.

videos.title: Scream Therapy
videos.overview: Fighting her new reality, Betty goes on the offense.

videos.title: The Twelfth of Never
videos.overview: Betty faces Dan in divorce court, and it sends her past a point of no return.

videos.title: The Shillelagh
videos.overview: Having lost her sense of identity, Betty can only see her own pain and turn it outward.

videos.title: Perception Is Reality
videos.overview: Empathy from strangers allows Betty to avoid facing what she's done, until she can't any more.
